name: NullPoint Technologies NeuroGuard NG-1 'Static'
description:
A pendant-sized device that generates a localized electromagnetic interference field designed to disrupt BCI communications within a two-meter radius. The NG-1 does not damage augmentations — it creates a zone of signal noise that degrades the wireless protocols used by neural interfaces to communicate with external systems. For attackers relying on BCI-coordinated combat augmentations, reflex-enhancement systems, or wirelessly linked targeting assists, the NG-1's interference field introduces lag, dropped connections, and phantom inputs that severely degrade their performance.

NullPoint Technologies is a small GLMZ firm founded by former neurosecurity researchers who recognized that the proliferation of combat-grade BCI augmentations among street-level criminals had created a defensive gap for unaugmented citizens. The NG-1 is their flagship product: affordable BCI disruption for people who cannot afford BCI augmentations of their own. The device is worn on a cord around the neck and activated by pressing a button on its face.

The NG-1's interference field is indiscriminate — it affects all BCI communications within range, including the user's own augmentations if they have them, and the augmentations of innocent bystanders. This has generated controversy, as the device can disrupt medical-grade neural interfaces (pain management, seizure prevention, mood regulation) in addition to combat augmentations. NullPoint's legal defense — that the device is no different from a radio jammer in principle — has not satisfied augmented rights advocates. The NG-1 retails for Φ190.
specifications:
interference radius: 2 meters
affected protocols: standard BCI wireless communications
effect on augmentations: signal lag, dropped connections, phantom inputs
activation: button press on device face
battery life: 45 minutes continuous
charging: micro-cell, 1 hour recharge
weight: 28 g
worn: neck pendant on cord
cost: Φ190
limitations: does not affect hardwired augmentations
tactical_use: Activate when threatened by an augmented attacker. The interference field degrades their BCI-dependent systems — reflex enhancement, targeting assists, sensory augmentation, and communication links will all experience disruption. The effect is not incapacitation but degradation: an augmented attacker becomes significantly less effective but is not disabled. Combine with physical deterrents (sprays, stun devices) for maximum effect. Be aware that your own augmentations and those of nearby civilians will also be affected.
cultural_context: The NG-1 sits at the intersection of personal defense and augmented rights, a position that generates constant debate. Unaugmented citizens view it as an essential equalizer in a world where augmented predators have overwhelming advantages. Augmented communities view it as a device that treats their bodies as threats to be disrupted. NullPoint navigates this tension by marketing exclusively to the unaugmented demographic and avoiding any messaging that frames augmented individuals as inherently dangerous — though the product's existence makes that implication unavoidable.
story_hooks: A hospital emergency room near a Tier 2 transit hub has seen a spike in augmentation-related medical emergencies — patients with seizure-prevention BCIs are having episodes triggered by NG-1 devices activated by commuters passing through the area.

NullPoint Technologies has been approached by a corporate faction wanting to license the NG-1's technology for a building-scale system — the implications of BCI disruption as architectural security are profound and troubling.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, teardrop-shaped pendant roughly the size of a thumb drive. The form is deliberately organic and non-threatening—it could pass as a piece of jewelry or a medical alert device to casual observation. The front face is slightly convex, dominated by a recessed button. Subtle ventilation channels run along the edges, suggesting the electromagnetic systems housed within.
physical_description.dimensions: 4.2 cm height × 2.8 cm width × 1.5 cm depth. Button face is roughly 0.8 cm diameter.
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively light—barely noticeable when worn, which is the intent. The weight distribution is balanced despite the dense EM components, sitting comfortably against the chest without pendant-swing fatigue.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade polymer composite with embedded shielding lattice. The core is a micro-EM generator wrapped in signal-isolation casing.
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal with a soft-touch rubberized coating that resists fingerprints and sweat. Subtle iridescent shift visible under direct light—a byproduct of the EM-shielding weave beneath the surface.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: charcoal gray with gunmetal accents. The recessed button is brushed titanium. A faint bioluminescent line (dim blue) traces the ventilation channels—activates when powered.
physical_description.grip_texture: The pendant itself has a soft, slightly tacky rubberized surface. The cord is braided synthetic polymer—grippy but not heavy, designed to hang invisibly under clothing.
distinctive_features: Recessed activation button with subtle tactile feedback ridge
Micro ventilation channels along the side edges—functional heat dissipation, aesthetically minimalist
Faint bioluminescent charging indicator strip along the base (blue when charged, dims during use)
Manufacturer logo laser-etched into the rear: 'NULLPOINT' in angular techno-font
Serial plate embedded flush on one side—difficult to remove without destroying the device
Micro LED on the face (white)—indicates active field generation when pressed
Subtle wear points where the cord passes through the eyelet—shows field usage despite careful handling
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: NULLPOINT TECHNOLOGIES logo laser-etched into the rear casing in 0.3 cm letters. A small compliance mark below: 'NG-1 | BCI DISRUPTOR | GLMZ LICENSED'. FCC-equivalent regulatory stamp on the side, barely visible.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually pristine—it's a consumer self-defense device kept on the person daily. Rarely shows heavy wear because it's activated only in threat situations. Occasionally shows minor cord fraying or small scuffs from pocket carry, but the polymer casing resists damage. The bioluminescent indicator may fade slightly with age.
